_note: Saved answers for ml/run/train.py (the 'train' section) and ml/run/watch.py (the 'watch' section). Run either script and choose 'Use the settings saved in default.json'. Edit the values and run again. Details: ml/run/README.md

train._note: The kind of training (neuroevolution or DQN) is chosen when train.py runs; only that kind's section is used. existing_run: 'continue' adds to a run that already exists, 'start_over' deletes it first (you still get a summary and a Start? question). When continuing, population/hidden/memory_size must match the run, and seed is ignored.

watch._note: Saved answers for ml/run/watch.py. You choose the type of watching (single, single_vs, multiple, multiple_vs) and, for single and multiple, evolution or DQN when the script runs; this file never decides that. Each kind has its own 'evolution' / 'dqn' sub-section with its run. A checkpoint is 'latest', 'best' (DQN runs only) or a saved generation/round number. seed null = new random obstacles. rows/cols null = the default shape.

single._note: Used when you choose single and then evolution or DQN. (The perfect bot needs no settings.)

single_vs._note: left is an evolution player, right is a DQN player; each side is a run and a checkpoint

multiple._note: Used when you choose multiple and then evolution or DQN. generations: the saved generations/rounds to show. Besides numbers you can write "latest" (the highest saved number) for either kind, and "best" (the best checkpoint) for a DQN run. Numbers are shown earliest first (top-left); "best" always comes last.

multiple_vs._note: left is evolution generations, right is DQN rounds (use 'best' for a DQN run's best checkpoint). Both lists need the same length: each row pairs one of each. Cols is always 2. rows null = one per pair
